messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — draft release notes for v2.3.1 are live for final signoff: https://internal.redwood.dev/rn/v2.3.1 (please don't externalize). Planning a staggered embargo: NA/EU go at 22:00 UTC, UK follows +30m to avoid partner maintenance window. Need ops/SRE signoff and one comms thumbs up. @marie?
marie: On it. I'll tweak the microcopy for the UK audience and add a one-line customer-facing blurb. Will post updated snippet in ~20m. :pencil2:
luca: Ops ok from infra side but request: can we pin the DB schema migration behind the first canary? want to avoid cross-region cascade. Also, deploy-bot needs the schedule command to include stagger param.
luca: FWIW here's what I'll schedule (feel free to copy):
```
/deploy schedule release v2.3.1 --window 2024-11-06T22:00Z --stagger "UK:+30m" --canaries 2
```
kyle: SRE signoff pending two things: rollout healthchecks and rollback criteria. Proposal: auto-roll if error rate >1.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency >2x baseline for 3m. Manual rollback allowed by oncall if customer-impacting.
anya: Agree to kyle's criteria. Also add a preflight smoke after canary #1 and before canary #2. Who can own the smoke? @luca?
luca: I'll run the smoke tests. Plan: after canary-1 finishes, I'll run `/smoke run release/v2.3.1 --suite quick` and paste logs. If green, continue.
marie: FYI comms copy: "Improved inference batching and lower tail latency. No client action required." I'm adding a short FAQ about a potential transient latency bump during schema rollouts.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled v2.3.1 for 2024-11-06T22:00Z (NA/EU), UK +30m. Canary policy: 2 canaries, 15m each. Artifacts: verified.
deploy-bot: Note: tag `release/v2.3.1` must be present in registry and digest match required. Use `/deploy tag-check release/v2.3.1` to verify.
anya: Great. Final checklist: 1) marshal microcopy from marie (in progress), 2) ops schedule (luca) — done, 3) SRE rollback criteria set (kyle) — done, 4) deploy-bot tag check (someone run before T-30m), 5) assign standby: @kyle will be oncall.
marie: Uploaded updated RN snippet and FAQ section: https://internal.redwood.dev/rn/v2.3.1#uk-snippet. Small wording note: replace "no client action required" with "no changes needed in your integration" for clarity.
kyle: I'll be on standby during the window. I'll create a quick pager rule: alert if errors >1% for 3m so we can eyeball earlier than auto-roll.
anya: Thanks all. If no objections, I'll publish the internal announce at T-60m and the public RN after UK window completes. Please run the tag check at T-30m. :thumbsup:
